name: lpk-mod
description: Early-access extras for lpk: /lpk-switch, /lpk-waive, a memory and quota hint before a fan-out, and compaction that keeps an lpk run's state. lpk works without it.

lpkRoot.title: lpk plugin folder
lpkRoot.description: The folder holding lpk's bin/lpk. Empty: the installed lpk plugin.

memoryFloorGb.title: Memory floor (GB)
memoryFloorGb.description: Below this much available memory, a second agent at once draws a hint to run the parts one at a time. lpk's own field of this name wins when it has one.

quotaFloorPercent.title: Quota floor (% left)
quotaFloorPercent.description: Below this share of a rate-limit window left, a new agent draws a hint. lpk's own field of this name wins when it has one.
